text:
maria: Cutting the Python + TS SDK publish in the 18:00-19:00 PT change window. Plan: canary -> smoke -> promote. Deprecating legacy sync client in this release (docs + migration snippet included). @samir will toggle rollback flag if anything breaks.

deploy-bot: canary publish started: npm:@redwood/sdk v1.12.0-rc.1, pypi:redwood-sdk==1.12.0rc1

samir: copying notes here — pinning guidance for customers: recommend pin to 1.11.x for mission-critical until we finish canary. We'll add an explicit compat shim note. Draft release notes at docs PR #432.

jonathan: Quick Q — are we auto-promoting rc -> latest, or manual promote after canary smoke? I prefer manual promote with a 30m observation period.

maria: manual promote. 30m smoke in staging, 15m canary in prod traffic at 1% then ramp 10%/10% with health checks. No auto-promote.

ellie: heads-up: legal asked we call out telemetry changes in the notes, include opt-out snippet.

deploy-bot: smoke tests: staging e2e started (job 5723).

deploy-bot: smoke tests: staging e2e FAILED — 2 flaky integration tests (kv-cache eviction) returning 502 in runtime service. See logs: https://ci/reports/5723

samir: saw the 502s. Rolling back canary tags and pinning publish to holdback. Maria — do you want immediate rollback to 1.11.x promotion stop?

maria: Hold promotion. Rollback canary tags now. Samir, please revert npm dist-tag and yank the rc on pypi, leave artifact in S3 archive. Add emergency note to release PR.

samir: done: npm tag removed, pypi rc yanked, retention set on artifacts. Created follow-up issue #790 to triage KV-cache eviction and re-run canary.

jonathan: Suggest we also ship a short patch to the runtime that disables the new KV prefetch flag behind a runtime flag so canary can proceed without the eviction risk. I can carve the patch if you want.

maria: Yes, that seems safest. Jonathan please open a small PR against runtime and link to the release PR. We'll re-schedule the canary for tomorrow same window after the patch and another quick smoke.

ellie: I'll update release notes to note the deprecation but mark the promotion delayed pending runtime patch. Add migration snippet and opt-out telemetry.

samir: FYI pinned customers list: enterprise accounts with SLA flagged to 1.11.x; emailing CSMs now.

maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) jonathan PR for runtime flag, (2) samir confirm artifact retention + docs PR link, (3) ellie update notes and legal snippet, (4) re-run canary tomorrow 18:00-19:00 PT if green. Will re-open channel when we're ready to re-promote. :white_check_mark:
